items.computation: The letter itself fixes the start of the period explicitly as its own date (19.11.2026, a Thursday) rather than the delivery day, so the Bekanntgabefiktion rules do not apply here. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (19.11.2026) is not counted, so the period starts 20.11.2026. The letter specifies 'Arbeitstage' are counted Monday-Friday with public holidays excluded, matching the standard Arbeitstage definition. Counting 12 such business days from 20.11.2026: Fri 20.11 (1), Mon 23.11 (2), Tue 24.11 (3), Wed 25.11 (4), Thu 26.11 (5), Fri 27.11 (6), Mon 30.11 (7), Tue 01.12 (8), Wed 02.12 (9), Thu 03.12 (10), Fri 04.12 (11), Mon 07.12 (12). No public holidays fall in this window in NRW. The 12th business day is Monday 07.12.2026, which is itself a working day, so no further weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.
